standards.description: Devices convert energy from one form to another; a battery converts chemical to electrical energy.
standards.traceDetail: Cutaway layers visibly convert chemical store into bulb glow.

standards.description: Electrical energy is produced and stored in chemical form by batteries.
standards.traceDetail: The battery's chemistry storing and releasing energy drives the loop.

standards.description: Electric forces arise from charged objects; the battery's terminals set up the push that moves charge.
standards.traceDetail: Terminal potential difference creates the driving electric push.
